description:
This is a Sources Sought Notice for project CL26068291 to be used for market research purposes in accordance with FAR Part 10. The Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) Weapons Support Columbus is seeking information regarding companies’ capabilities to provide the item listed below under a potential Indefinite Quantity Contract (IQC).

This notice is issued solely for informational and planning purposes. It does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP). Please review the attached questionnaire and spreadsheet. If you are interested in this opportunity, please fill out both and return to Jeremy.Feeney@dla.mil by the date and time indicated herein. Thank you in advance for your assistance.
